name: huracan-dead-title
note: Non-repairable title with cited wreck prices and thin part-out citations. hand-converted 2026-08-17 from the recorded freeform findings into typed comps, each as its source stated it.

areas.description: Front bumper fascia destroyed, headlights smashed/displaced, hood buckled, and front crash-can/radiator support structure visibly crushed and pushed rearward on both the driver and passenger sides. This is a broad, full-width frontal hit, not a light cosmetic bumper tap - likely compromised front frame rails/crash structure requiring structural replacement.

Right-side fender crumpled and folded back to the door line/wheel arch; wheel appears to sit at a slightly altered angle suggesting force transmitted rearward into the corner, worth inspecting the front suspension pickup points on that side.

Wheel alignment/camber in photo 2 looks slightly off compared to the clean geometry on the left side (photo 1), consistent with a hit hard enough to tweak a control arm, tie rod, or subframe mount on the right front corner. Cannot confirm bend without underside photos.

Driver and passenger front airbags have deployed, with residual bag fabric hanging from the steering wheel and dash/A-pillar area; SRS module, wiring harness, and seatbelt pretensioners will all need replacement/reset for any future use.
Rear bumper, diffuser, taillights and engine cover glass all appear factory-straight with no signs of impact, staining, or misalignment - damage is isolated to the front of the car.

V10 engine and visible ancillary components under the rear glass look undisturbed with no obvious fluid leaks, but since the engine sits well aft of the crush zone the mid-engine layout likely spared the drivetrain from direct impact.

triage.drivetrainRisk: The mid-engine V10 and transaxle sit well behind the crush zone and show no visible leaks or displacement in the engine-bay glass shot, so direct mechanical damage to the drivetrain itself is unlikely; the bigger risk is the front crash structure, cooling radiators, and front suspension/subframe mounts which took the brunt of the hit and will need thorough inspection.

observations.note: Right-front corner shows crumpled bumper/fender, headlight area pushed in; wheel/tire look intact and properly aligned.
Left side profile relatively clean - shows factory wheels, no obvious side intrusion, confirms damage is front-concentrated.
Rear-quarter view shows crumpled right front fender pushed rearward into door line and wheel arch, tire seems to be leaning inward - possible suspension geometry shift transmitted from front hit.
Front right view: bumper cover torn away exposing crash structure, headlight housing cracked/dislodged, radiator support/crash can visibly deformed and pushed back with wiring/hardware hanging loose.

Direct front view confirms both headlights/bumper fascia removed or destroyed, front clip structure crumpled, hood is buckled at leading edge, left corner also showing impact damage suggesting a broad frontal impact rather than a narrow offset hit.
Rear view is clean - taillights, diffuser, exhaust, engine cover glass all intact, no evidence of secondary rear impact.

Interior driver side shows deployed airbag (steering wheel bag fired, hanging fabric) and deployed knee/side airbag remnants visible near dash - confirms frontal impact severity was sufficient to trigger SRS.
Passenger side interior shows deployed airbag residue on dash/A-pillar area; seats and console otherwise appear undamaged cosmetically.
Dash cluster photo shows odometer reading ~7721 miles, low-mileage car, confirms Huracan EVO trim.
Wide interior shot reconfirms airbag deployment cloth hanging from steering wheel, no fire or water staining visible on carpets/seats.
Engine bay glass view from above shows V10 engine intact, no visible fluid leakage, coolant hoses and intake plumbing appear undisturbed - engine sits well aft of the crush zone.
VIN/certification tag photo, confirms Huracan EVO RWD build plate, no damage-relevant info beyond ID confirmation.

prices.item: front bumper cover / spoiler assembly, genuine
